services.heading: Hardwood, Start to Finish
services.intro: Full-service hardwood flooring for homes across Colorado and Southern Wyoming.

items.title: Hardwood Installation
items.description: Solid and engineered hardwood, installed from subfloor to finish. We do the whole job, start to end.

items.title: Sanding & Refinishing
items.description: Dustless sanding and quality finishes that make old floors look new again. You'd be surprised what's hiding under the wear.

items.title: Floor Repair
items.description: Water damage, scratches, and loose boards fixed right. We match your existing flooring so you can't tell where the repair was.

items.title: Custom Staining
items.description: Pick your color and we'll make it happen. Even coats, clean lines, and a finish that lasts.

items.title: Door-to-Floor Consults
items.description: We bring samples to your home so you can see colors in your own lighting. No showroom trip needed.

items.title: Stair Refinishing
items.description: Treads, risers, and railings sanded and refinished to match your floors. Your stairs get the same work as every other room.

about.heading: About Young & Sons
about.quote: Do it right the first time and you'll never have to do it again.
about.body:
**Five generations.** Since 1902, the Young family has been working with wood. **Kendall Young** carries that tradition forward, perfecting hardwood floors across Northern Colorado and Southern Wyoming. What started over a century ago has grown into a family business built on honest work and fair prices.

At Young & Sons, we only do hardwood. It's all we know, and we know it well. Every quote includes labor and materials upfront. No hidden costs.

contact.pricing_note: **All quotes include labor & materials.** No hidden fees, no surprises. What we quote is what you pay.
